achievements.name: Cast Member
achievements.description: Complete the story's opening sequence in any mode.

achievements.name: Black Marketeer
achievements.description: Get yourself a cool new weapon.

achievements.name: Nail File Cake
achievements.description: Free a fellow prisoner.

achievements.name: Seasoned Performer
achievements.description: Complete the first four finales in any mode.

achievements.name: Virtuoso
achievements.description: Get an A++ in 10 levels.

achievements.name: Solo Star
achievements.description: Get a letter grade in every level (except Encores) in Normal Solo Story Mode.

achievements.name: Coop Star
achievements.description: Get a letter grade in every level (except Encores) in Normal Co-op Story Mode.

achievements.name: Insane Solo Star
achievements.description: Get a letter grade  in every level (except Encores) in insane solo story mode.

achievements.name: Insane Coop Star
achievements.description: Get a letter grade in every level (except Encores) in insane co-op story mode.

achievements.name: Crowd Pleaser
achievements.description: Complete all the Encores in any mode.

achievements.name: Secret Hat Hunter
achievements.description: Collect 10 Golden Hats.

achievements.name: Hats Off
achievements.description: Get a letter grade in all eight finales in any mode.

achievements.name: The Professional
achievements.description: Be on the winning team in 100 arena matches.

achievements.name: All Around Joe
achievements.description: Be on the winning team in one arena match of every mode.

achievements.name: Jail Breaker
achievements.description: Free 50 prisoners in the Gift Shop.

achievements.name: Social Butterfly
achievements.description: Collect all the prisoners of one head shape.

achievements.name: Freedom Hero
achievements.description: Free all the prisoners in the Gift Shop by unlocking or trading.

achievements.name: Armed and Dangerous
achievements.description: Collect all the weapons in the Gift Shop by unlocking or trading.

achievements.name: First Time Trader
achievements.description: Make a trade with someone.

achievements.name: Take A Bow
achievements.description: Complete an encore level in Story Mode.

achievements.name: Deadly Performer
achievements.description: Get 100 kills.

achievements.name: Chicken Toucher
achievements.description: Play with the Behemoth or someone with this achievement in an online game.

achievements.name: Melee Master
achievements.description: Successfully use every melee attack move.

achievements.name: Weapons Master
achievements.description: Use each weapon successfully.

achievements.name: Theater Critic
achievements.description: Complete 10 user-created levels in a single Featured Story playlist.

achievements.name: Theater Manager
achievements.description: Download and host a game of user-created levels.
